mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the loop was most worthwhile because the result described the complete biscuit journey. Yes, playing through felt worth the small effort: the assembly was straightforward, and the finished project gave it a clear purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual wheel fitting was the least interesting part: it was predictable, though it helped build the carrier.

surprise.text: The finished description clarified that a separate loop moves the trolley while its wheels ride on the support cord.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt purposeless; each fitted a part into the carrier.

continue.text: I would probably not choose another chapter: the finished mechanism was satisfying, but following the assembly goals involved little decision-making.
